copy.curiosityHook: What happens when an outsider's carefully nurtured delusion crashes into an unforgiving dose of reality?
copy.description: Photo lab technician Sy Parrish has developed snapshots for the Yorkin family for years, but his isolated existence gradually twists into an unhealthy belief that he belongs inside their picture-perfect world.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful psychological drama built on isolation and quiet tension, rewarding engaged solitary viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Mark Romanek steers this taut 96-minute thriller with quiet precision, letting an intimate drama of loneliness build into an unsettling study of suburban obsession.
